name: cycles-of-survival
description: Cycles of Survival: PNG generators for cards and board.

scripts.watch: npm run generate:cards && npm run generate:board && chokidar "game/config/*.json" -c "npm run generate:cards && npm run generate:board"
scripts.watch:cards: npm run generate:cards && chokidar "game/config/cards.json" -c "npm run generate:cards"
scripts.watch:board: npm run generate:board && chokidar "game/config/board.json" -c "npm run generate:board"
scripts.watch:cards:sheet: npm run generate:cards:sheet && npm run watch:cards
scripts.watch:cards:single: npm run generate:cards:single && chokidar "game/config/cards.json" -c "npm run generate:cards:single"
scripts.generate:organisms:all: npm run generate:organisms:working && npm run generate:organisms:base-set && npm run generate:organisms:jurassic && npm run generate:organisms:lichen-moss-fungi && npm run generate:organisms:symbiotic-powerhouse && npm run generate:organisms:bushes && npm run generate:organisms:shrubs && npm run generate:organisms:vines && npm run generate:organisms:herbaceous && npm run generate:organisms:ground-cover && npm run generate:organisms:overstory && npm run generate:organisms:understory
